scenarios.prompt: A world cycle drives schedules and lighting from one canonical clock. Define a versioned cycle and transition identity.

criteria.identity: time_cycle_id/revision, clock source and transition identity are explicit.
criteria.ownership: Consumers read canonical time without becoming a second clock owner.
criteria.replay: Save/resume/time-skip behavior produces deterministic transitions without duplicate emission.
